plugin.name: Manual server install tools
plugin.description: Not needed with a current CHIM: the server plugin is installed automatically when the game starts (CHIM syncs Data/CHIM/server-plugins to its server). Pick this only if that does not happen on your CHIM version. It adds the folder "CHIM ORomance Bridge Server Tools" with Install-ServerPlugin.bat (copies the plugin into the DwemerAI WSL distro) and Uninstall-ServerPlugin.bat (removes it and its actions).

plugin.name: Papyrus source files
plugin.description: The .psc sources in Data/Source/Scripts. Only needed if you want to read or change the scripts.
